tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a goal only when explicitly requested by the user or system/developer instructions; do not infer goals from ordinary tasks. Set token_budget only when an explicit token budget is requested. Fails if an unfinished goal exists; use update_goal only for status.

objective.description: Required. The concrete objective to start pursuing. This starts a new active goal when no goal exists or replaces the current goal when it is complete.

token_budget.description: Positive token budget for the new goal. Omit unless explicitly requested.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update the existing goal. Use this tool only to mark the goal achieved or genuinely blocked. Set status to complete only when the objective has actually been achieved and no required work remains. Set status to blocked only when the same blocking condition has repeated for at least three consecutive goal turns, counting the original/user-triggered turn and any automatic continuations, and the agent cannot make meaningful progress without user input or an external-state change.

status.description: Required. Set to complete only when the objective is achieved and no required work remains. Set to blocked only after the same blocking condition has recurred for at least three consecutive goal turns and the agent is at an impasse. After a previously blocked goal is resumed, the resumed run starts a fresh blocked audit.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Get the current goal for this thread, including status, budgets, token and elapsed-time usage, and remaining token budget.

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Show current goal status and details.

commands.name: goal.set
commands.description: Create a new goal or replace existing goal.

commands.name: goal.edit
commands.description: Edit current goal objective or token budget.

token_budget.description: Adjusted token budget (positive integer or null to uncap).

commands.name: goal.resume
commands.description: Resume paused, blocked, or limited goal.

commands.name: goal.load_objective
commands.description: Retrieve full objective text for large goals.
